text: Skip to main content Report fraud More In Help Interactive Tax Assistant Tools Report fraud Tax fraud or a scam Fake IRS email or message Tax return preparer Tax scams Identity theft Notices and letters Appeals Frequently asked questions Accessibility Contact your local IRS office Contact an international IRS office Tax topics Other languages Submit a tip to the IRS If you know about tax fraud, scams, illegal activity, had your tax information stolen, or have other similar information, report it to us. Tax fraud or scam Confidentially report suspected tax fraud, scams, abusive schemes, evasion, or law violations. You may qualify for a monetary award through the Whistleblower Office. Report tax fraud or a scam Fake IRS email or message IRS and Treasury impersonators threaten or pressure for information or money. Report emails, texts, social media accounts, calls and letters that claim to be from us. Report a fake IRS message or call Identity theft Report if you or your organization are the victim of tax-related ID theft. Report theft of tax identification numbers or data breaches of tax-related information. Learn what to do if you received an ID theft letter from the IRS. Get identity theft help Tax return preparer Report paid tax return preparers filing fraudulent returns or not following proper tax preparation practices. Tax preparers can also self-report data breaches, return count mismatches, PTIN, or other issues. Report an issue Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 25-Jun-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print
